title: GitHub Repo Search output
description: One row per repository matching a search query. A failed query yields one row with an error field.

repos.title: Repos
repos.description: Default dataset with all repo rows (query, full_name, url, description, language, stars, forks, open_issues, topics, license, dates, archived, owner, owner_type).

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Key-value store record SUMMARY: {queries, repos} counts for the run.
